meta.radiance_units: W m-2 sr-1 um-1 (L1b photon radiance x hc/lambda)
meta.polarization_note: OCO-2 measures one linear polarization: the L1b radiance is that component, about half of the total intensity for an unpolarized scene. Compare with an unpolarized forward model L as polarization_factor * L.

meta.good_note: good = L1b bad_sample_list == 0 and finite radiance
